1.consolidated_definition: Expresión onomatopéyica para expresar el ruido que hace el que roe algo duro, o el serrucho al cortar madera.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Onomatopoeic expression to convey the sound made by something scraping against a hard surface or a saw cutting through wood.
